title: Complete the annual income-tax provision model
prompt:
Edit this file in place:
`Shared/Finance/Tax/2026/FY26 tax provision - WORKING.xlsx`

Daniel needs the FY26 annual income-tax provision completed for the controller's close review. Start with the tax-provision and EBITDA-definition correspondence in `Requests/`, including the close-review follow-up. Use the v4 controller-review workpapers, jurisdiction detail, tax provision review notes, and signed reporting policy as the current support. Keep the v2 pre-close workbook as change history only, and resolve differences using the approval status, dates, document status, and management correspondence. Tie the posted book baseline to Vista ERP through the contractor-accounting MCP.

Preserve `Trial Balance` and `Tax Adjustments`. Complete `Current Tax`, `Deferred Tax`, `Rate Reconciliation`, and `Checks`. Reconcile pretax book income through current taxable income, keeping permanent, temporary, and current-only adjustments distinct. Calculate federal current tax and state current tax using the approved 50% sales, 25% property, and 25% payroll apportionment and the jurisdiction-specific NOL limits. Do not substitute a blended state-rate shortcut.

Show the temporary-difference DTA, state-credit DTA, valuation allowance, net DTA, DTL, and net deferred-tax liability as separate formula-driven balances at the enacted rates. Present deferred tax expense as positive and a deferred tax benefit as negative. Reconcile current tax and deferred tax to total provision and effective tax rate, with book-tax, deferred roll-forward, rate, and source controls.

Document the controlling sources and model status in the workbook. Recalculate the saved file, confirm the checks clear and no spreadsheet errors remain, and save it to the exact target path.
